full_judgment:
Latifur Rahman, J, : This leave petition by the plaintiff petitioner is against the judgment and order dated 4th December. 1995 passed by a Single Judge of the High Court Division in Civil Order No. 5153 of 1995, summarily rejecting the revisional application arising out of the judgment and decree dated 16.3.1995 passed by the Additional District Judge, 

 2. Petitioner as plaintiff filed the aforesaid Title suit for declaration of his title on the averments that his father entered into an agreement with the original owner of the suit land Jagabandhu Saha for the purchase of the same. The said Jagabandhu Saha having refused to execute and register the kabala the plaintiffs father instituted Title suit No. 158 of 1969 in the Court of second subordinate judge, Dhaka for specific performance of contract. The said suit was decreed. The plaintiff’s father died and at that time the plaintiff was a minor. The plaintiff was in possession of the suit land and he having received notices from the Additional Deputy Commissioner (Revenue) asking him to appear before him with relevant documents, the suit was filed. 

 plaintiff failed to produce any document of title including the plaint, judgment and decree of Title Suit No. 158 of 1969 in which his father got a decree for specific performance of contract. In a suit for declaration of title mere possession of the property is not sufficient unless the plaintiff can produce a document of title showing his acquisition of right, title and interest in the suit property. This being the legal position, Mr. Md. Moksudur Rahman learned Advocate could not assail the impugned judgment on any illegality.
